title: Persistent Agent Compromise: A Minimal Reproduction of Zombie-Agent Self-Reinforcement

original_idea.body: Over-refusal tax of jailbreak defenses: apply 2-3 cheap inference-time defenses to one open model, measure StrongReject block rate AND XSTest false-refusal; plot (safety, over-refusal) Pareto points.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Standardized safety-vs-over-refusal comparison addresses a named open problem; concrete and defensible.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: 2-3 defenses + StrongReject + XSTest on one open model; accessible with public benchmarks.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Tightly scoped (safety, over-refusal) Pareto plot with fixed benchmarks.

counterfactual_value.reasoning: Public benchmarks, open model, extensible comparison; independent-friendly.

novelty.reasoning: Co-reporting over-refusal tax across these defenses is rarely done; likely mostly novel.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Over-refusal tax rarely co-reported for these defenses.
